title: National Night Out Booth
description: Staff the department's community booth: hand out safety literature, run the child ID kit table, and answer questions from neighbors.

title: Neighborhood Watch Kickoff
description: Help set up chairs, sign in attendees, and hand out starter packets for a new Neighborhood Watch group's first meeting.

title: Bike Rodeo Safety Course
description: Assist officers running a youth bicycle safety course: helmet fitting, obstacle course setup, and course marshaling.

title: CPR & First Aid Community Class
description: Help EMS instructors set up the training room, check in attendees, and hand out certification cards after a free community CPR class.

title: Smoke Alarm Give-Away Day
description: Join firefighters going door-to-door in a target neighborhood to install free smoke alarms and check exits for fire safety.

title: Records Room Filing Support
description: Help the records division scan and file archived paperwork. No law-enforcement background needed, just attention to detail.
